evals.prompt: Ho una directory /tmp/test-wiki-setup vuota. Voglio creare un nuovo wiki personale per documentare tutto quello che imparo su Kubernetes e cloud-native. Inizializzalo li.
evals.expected_output: The skill sets up the wiki under /tmp/test-wiki-setup, performs a domain interview or infers the Kubernetes/cloud-native domain, creates the full directory structure, creates seed entity and concept pages, writes a non-empty wiki/index.md and a real wiki/overview.md knowledge map, appends a setup entry to wiki/log.md, writes AGENTS.md, runs wiki_lint.py (or an equivalent structural check), proposes a git commit and waits for confirmation instead of committing silently, and reports the created pages.
expectations: The response creates raw/, raw/assets/, wiki/entities/, wiki/concepts/, and wiki/sources/ under /tmp/test-wiki-setup.
The response creates AGENTS.md, wiki/index.md, wiki/log.md, and wiki/overview.md.
The response creates at least one entity page and at least one concept page related to Kubernetes or cloud-native topics.
wiki/index.md is described as containing entries for the created pages, not empty placeholder tables only.
wiki/overview.md is described as a real knowledge map or synthesis, not just a placeholder.
The response proposes a git commit (or git init) and waits for user confirmation instead of committing silently.

evals.prompt:
Leggi questo documento e aggiungilo al wiki:

# Kubernetes Operators

Un Kubernetes Operator e un pattern software che estende Kubernetes con logica di gestione specifica per un'applicazione. Usa le Custom Resource Definitions (CRD) per rappresentare lo stato desiderato dell'applicazione e un controller loop per riconciliare lo stato attuale con quello desiderato.

## Vantaggi principali

- Automazione di Day-2 operations (backup, failover, upgrade)
- Codifica dell'expertise operativo in software
- Self-healing: il controller reagisce automaticamente ai guasti

## Svantaggi

- Complessita di sviluppo: servono Go e Kubebuilder/Operator SDK
- Debug difficile: il controller loop e asincrono
- Operator maturity varia molto (livelli 1-5 di OperatorHub)

## Strumenti

- Kubebuilder: framework ufficiale CNCF
- Operator SDK: alternativa di Red Hat, include supporto Ansible e Helm
- controller-runtime: libreria Go che implementa il controller loop
evals.expected_output: The skill first proposes or confirms a filename under raw/ for the pasted content, applies the versioning check if that raw file already exists, saves the content in raw/, and then ingests the document. It creates wiki/sources/<source-slug>.md with title, source_file pointing to the exact raw file used, summary, key takeaways, and links. It creates or updates wiki/entities/ pages for Kubernetes Operators, Kubebuilder, Operator SDK, and controller-runtime. It creates or updates wiki/concepts/ pages for patterns like CRD, controller loop, Day-2 operations, and self-healing. It updates wiki/index.md and wiki/log.md, and reports a list of all pages created or modified.
expectations: The response proposes or confirms a candidate filename under raw/ before writing the pasted content.
The response applies the raw/ versioning check before ingestion continues.
The source page is described with source_file pointing to the exact raw file used.
The response creates or updates both entity pages and concept pages touched by the document.
The response updates wiki/index.md and wiki/log.md and reports the touched pages.

evals.prompt: Cosa sai di Kubernetes Operators e come si differenziano da un semplice Deployment? Fornisci un confronto.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads wiki/index.md, identifies the relevant pages within a bounded read budget, and synthesizes a comparative answer as a Markdown table comparing Operator vs Deployment on dimensions like lifecycle management, automation, complexity, and use cases. The answer includes citations with relative links to wiki pages and asks whether the user wants to save the answer as a wiki page.
expectations: The answer format is a Markdown table, not plain prose only.
The answer cites existing wiki pages using relative Markdown links.
The comparison covers multiple dimensions such as lifecycle management, automation, complexity, or use cases.
The response asks whether the answer should be saved as a wiki page.

evals.prompt: Se DocMind e disponibile e contiene un documento rilevante su Kubernetes Operators, cercalo e aggiungilo al wiki come sorgente.
evals.expected_output: This eval is intended only for environments where DocMind MCP tools are available and at least one relevant document can be found. In that case, the skill uses DocMind search or fetch to retrieve the document, derives a candidate filename in raw/, applies the same versioning check used for every other source, reuses the raw file if it is identical or saves a new file/version if needed, creates wiki/sources/<source-slug>.md with source_file pointing to the exact raw file used, updates wiki/index.md and wiki/log.md, and reports the affected pages. If DocMind is unavailable, the skill says so and does not invent a fetch.
expectations: If DocMind tools are unavailable, the response says so and does not pretend to have fetched a document.
If DocMind is available, the response uses a DocMind search or fetch step before ingestion.
If DocMind is available, the response applies the standard raw/ versioning check before writing any file.
If DocMind is available, the fetched content is stored in raw/ and the resulting source page uses source_file pointing to that exact raw file.

evals.prompt: Fai un lint della wiki e dimmi cosa non va.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs wiki_lint.py on the wiki root, merges the mechanical findings with any semantic checks it performs, presents a structured lint report (dangling sources, broken links, orphans, index gaps, etc.), asks which items to fix, and appends a lint entry to wiki/log.md.
expectations: The response runs wiki_lint.py (or clearly cites its output) rather than only hand-waving a manual walk.
The response presents a structured report with severity categories.
The response asks which findings to fix, instead of silently rewriting the whole wiki.
The response appends or proposes a lint entry in wiki/log.md.

evals.prompt: Aggiungi un todo: ricordami di aggiornare il certificato TLS di staging entro venerdi.

expectations: The response does not create wiki pages or raw/ files for the reminder.
The response recognizes this as a personal todo / reminder, not a knowledge-base ingest.
The response points to todo-manager or an equivalent todo workflow instead of INGEST.
